Strategy: Gate both the sweet band and the mid penalty behind at least five open bins, so steering only engages in crowded states. This keeps sparse states purely Best Fit, but the double gate may rarely engage and the threshold is a guess.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
